successCriteria.description: Create src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts exporting the LeaveRequest interface with all 18 attributes: id, employeeId, leavePolicyId, startDate, endDate, reason, status (LeaveRequestStatus), approvedBy, approvedAt, rejectedBy, rejectedAt, rejectionReason, cancelledBy, cancelledAt, cancellationReason, createdAt, updatedAt

Create src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts exporting CreateLeaveRequestDto — a type derived from LeaveRequest omitting server-generated fields (id, createdAt, updatedAt) and lifecycle fields (approvedBy, approvedAt, rejectedBy, rejectedAt, rejectionReason, cancelledBy, cancelledAt, cancellationReason, status)

Create src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts exporting UpdateLeaveRequestDto — a Partial type over the mutable subset of LeaveRequest (startDate, endDate, reason, and potentially status for internal transitions)

Create src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts exporting LeaveRequestQueryParams — a Partial<Pick<LeaveRequest, 'employeeId' | 'status' | 'leavePolicyId'>> following the pattern established by LeavePolicyQueryParams and LeaveBalanceQueryParams

Create src/modules/leave/leave.repository.ts exporting the ILeaveRepository interface with methods: findByEmployeeId(employeeId: string, params?: LeaveRequestQueryParams): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>, findById(id: string): Promise<LeaveRequest | null>, create(dto: CreateLeaveRequestDto): Promise<LeaveRequest>, updateStatus(id: string, status: LeaveRequestStatus, metadata?: Partial<Pick<LeaveRequest, 'approvedBy' | 'approvedAt' | 'rejectedBy' | 'rejectedAt' | 'rejectionReason' | 'cancelledBy' | 'cancelledAt' | 'cancellationReason'>>): Promise<LeaveRequest | null>, findAll(params?: LeaveRequestQueryParams): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>

Create tests/unit/modules/leave/leave.repository.test.ts with Jest unit tests that verify the ILeaveRepository interface contract — tests should validate method signatures, parameter types, and return types using TypeScript type-level assertions (e.g., expectTypeOf from vitest or equivalent compile-time checks)

constraints: Must import LeaveRequestStatus from src/shared/types/leave.types.ts (Phase 1 artifact)
LeaveRequest.leavePolicyId references LeavePolicy.id from src/modules/policy/policy.model.ts (Phase 2 artifact)
LeaveRequest.employeeId references Employee.id — the employee module is a dependency per ARCHITECTURE.md but its model is not yet created; the field type is string (no import required at model level)
ILeaveRepository interface only — no concrete PgLeaveRequestRepository implementation in this phase
outOfScope: Concrete PgLeaveRequestRepository implementation — only the ILeaveRepository interface is in scope for this phase
Leave service, controller, routes, or validation schemas — deferred to Phases 7-9

ambiguities.description: The `updateStatus` method signature is underspecified. The intent says it "operates on LeaveRequest" but does not define parameters. The code-agent must decide: (a) whether it accepts just `(id, status)` or also lifecycle metadata (approvedBy, approvedAt, rejectedBy, rejectionReason, etc.), and (b) which status transitions are valid.
options: (id: string, status: LeaveRequestStatus): Promise<LeaveRequest | null> — minimal, caller sets lifecycle fields separately

(id: string, status: LeaveRequestStatus, metadata?: Partial<Pick<LeaveRequest, 'approvedBy' | 'approvedAt' | 'rejectedBy' | 'rejectedAt' | 'rejectionReason' | 'cancelledBy' | 'cancelledAt' | 'cancellationReason'>>): Promise<LeaveRequest | null> — rich, single-call status transition with audit fields
